{{Top|leg}}
[[File:R2SensorArray-TESB.png|250px|thumb|R2-D2's sensor array]]
An '''R2 sensor array''', also known as a '''Scan-mode sensor''', was a scanner array that was standard for [[Industrial Automaton/Legends|Industrial Automaton's]] [[R2-series astromech droid/Legends|R2-series astromech droid]]. The device could monitor radiation levels and detect nearby lifeforms.<ref name="CCG">{{CCG|set=Hoth Limited|cardname=R2 Sensor Array}}</ref> The scanner rose out of a [[Droid/Legends|droid's]] dome on a hydraulic extension with a reinforced metal rod. At the top was a signal amplifier with a two small lights and square, curved lifeform scanner<ref name="Blueprints">''[[Star Wars Blueprints: The Ultimate Collection]]''</ref> comprised of life-scan mesh. A cable at the bottom of the rod served as the main logic processor connection.<ref name="TVD">''[[Star Wars: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref>

[[R2-D2]] had one of the scanners which he used at various times, including while searching for signs of [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] when the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] was lost on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] shortly before the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]].<ref name="TESB">{{Film|V}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
An image of R2-D2 from {{Film|V}} using this scanner was featured on the packaging of [[Kenner Products|Kenner's]] [[1981]] action figure of R2-D2 with an extendible [[Droid sensorscope|sensorscope]]<ref name="Kenner">{{KennerCite|set=Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Back (toy line)|pack=Artoo-Detoo (R2-D2) with Sensorscope|link=VINtR2D2scope.asp}}</ref>, but later sources confirmed the sensorscope was a different scanner used later in the film.<ref name="CCG" />
